title: Surface Braid Invariants from Yang-Baxter Operators and Their Cohomology
summary: Surface braids are a generalization of braids to surfaces in the 4-disk. They are described by planar graphs called charts, and sequences of braid words called braid systems, that represent monodromies of branch points in projections. Yang-Baxter operators (YBOs) have been used extensively in knot theory for constructions of Jones and other polynomials, defined by braid group representations.
